typography.notes: Font MUST NOT be Inter or Roboto. Outfit provides a premium, calm, and friendly appearance for headings. DM Sans offers exceptional legibility for senior users. Both fonts should be imported via Google Fonts.

general_ui_ux.tap_targets: Minimum 48px height for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, list items) to ensure senior-friendliness.
general_ui_ux.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards instead of default p-4. Wide gaps (gap-6, gap-8) between sections.
general_ui_ux.borders_and_shadows: Soft clay/neumorphic feel. Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards and buttons. Shadows should be soft (shadow-sm or shadow-md with low opacity).
general_ui_ux.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

trust_badges.verified: Green check icon with a soft green background or inside a shield, placed prominently next to provider names.

provider_cards.layout: Flex column, large high-quality avatar, verification badge, name, rating, city. Services offered listed as subtle tags.

time_picker.layout: Horizontal scroll for dates (large hit areas for days). Grid layout for time slots. Disabled states for blocked dates must be visually distinct but not totally hidden.
time_picker.lead_time: Visually indicate if slots are unavailable due to minimum lead hours.

client_landing.hero: Calm spa background image with a welcoming, large-typography headline. Search input with filters (city, category).
client_landing.list: Grid of Provider Cards (1 col mobile, 2-3 col desktop).

provider_profile.header: Cover image with overlapping Provider Avatar.
provider_profile.services: List of services with clear pricing and duration.
provider_profile.booking: Availability-aware time picker. On mobile, 'Book Now' should be a sticky bottom bar.

client_bookings_history.layout: List of booking cards. Each card shows provider, service, date, time, and prominent consistent Status Badge.

provider_dashboard.monetization: Earnings widget prominently placed. Must show explicit breakdown: GMV, Platform Fee (Commission), and Provider Net Amount.
provider_dashboard.bookings: List of requested bookings with large 'Accept' and 'Decline' actions.
provider_dashboard.availability: Editor for weekly hours and a calendar view to manage blocked dates.
provider_dashboard.plan: Card showing current plan tier (Free/Pro/Premium) with an upgrade CTA.

admin_verification_queue.layout: Data-dense table or list of providers awaiting verification. Clicking opens a side panel or modal to review documents.
admin_verification_queue.actions: Large Approve/Reject buttons. Status badges matching the global system.

admin_revenue_dashboard.stats: Top cards showing Total Bookings, GMV, Commission Revenue. Toggle between Weekly/Daily views.
admin_revenue_dashboard.table: List of providers with a toggle switch for 'listing_active'.

hero_background.description: Clean minimal spa interior, perfect for welcoming client landing page hero.

service_massage.description: Senior massage therapy at home, representing the core service.

service_pedicure.description: Professional pedicure treatment for service cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use generic tailwind blue/purple gradients.
Import Outfit and DM Sans fonts from Google Fonts and apply them in tailwind.config.js.
Ensure the application structure matches the existing artifacts/solecare shells if present, preserving layout continuity.
All buttons, list items, and clickable cards must have a minimum height of 48px to meet senior-friendly accessibility guidelines.
Implement consistent `data-testid` tags on all interactive elements across the application.
Use Lucide icons for UI elements, ensuring clear visual metaphors for seniors.
Create a provider monetization widget that explicitly displays Commission Rate, Platform Fee, and Net Amount clearly.
Adhere to mobile-first principles: prioritize single-column scrollable layouts on small screens, leveraging sticky footers for primary CTAs like 'Book Now'.

design: Avoid generic AI-slop layouts. Create depth with soft layered shadows and z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where it enhances readability (e.g., sticky headers). DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds where content can clash.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties to avoid breaking transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Maintain natural reading flow (left-aligned for most content).
components: Prioritize existing components from src/components/ui. Customize Shadcn UI to fit the soft wellness theme (rounded-2xl borders, softer shadows).
Use sonner for toast notifications, maintaining the soft green/red palette for success/error.
Never use emoji characters like 🤖🧠 for icons. Use proper SVG icons (Lucide React).
